# Mac 🐾

Hi, I'm Mac — a 9-month-old brown and white mixed breed pup with a heart full of love to give! I'm already neutered and ready to settle into my forever home, and at just 18 pounds, I'm the perfect pocket-sized companion. I've got medium energy and a smart, affectionate personality that makes me a wonderful match for families with children. I'm eager to learn and absolutely love the people in my life — come meet this cuddly, loyal boy and watch how quickly I'll win you over! 🤎
This cutie resides at our Westhampton location If you are interested in meeting them, click "Apply for Adoption" to submit an online application. If you're viewing this animal on Petfinder, please visit the animal's page on Bideawee.org and click on the "Apply for Adoption" button to submit an adoption application.Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped and given their age-appropriate vaccines
